issues.description: The now-trivial `view_rec_finite` proof helper is unused and unnecessarily expands the proof API.
issues.rationale: After the Verus set migration, the helper has an empty body and its own comment says finiteness is trivially true. A complete search of the selected snapshot finds no caller beyond the definition. The `avoid-unused-spec-helpers` guideline requires newly unnecessary proof helpers with zero call sites to be removed. Reviewer 3386412310 asks whether it is still needed; the author answers `nope` and commits to removing it, and the final approved head deletes the function.
